program.name: Shirt Off
program.subject: Beach body
program.blurb: Shirt off, no equipment: push-up and floor-pull circuits, abs and legs, a burn so you stay ready to fuck her.
program.about: The body you fuck her in, with no gym. One day is a circuit of push-up variations, pike push-ups and abs; the other is floor pulls, legs and glutes. A short Tabata finishes both so you stay lean. Everything happens on the floor, so it travels well. Level II adds reps and Level III makes every hold longer.
